Name: TownCrier
Author: lunan12323
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Describe the main purpose of your mod[/color][/size]
A co-op social mod. Every couple of in-game hours it tells the farm what each player has been doing — fishing, mining, farming and so on — read from vanilla statistics. Emotes reach across the valley to answer someone else's, and a short "Morning Post" runs each dawn.
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Lay out any steps users must follow to install your mod[/color][/size]
Install SMAPI 4.1.0+
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Describe the core features of your mod[/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Behaviour broadcasts[/b] — activity summaries every 2 in-game hours, max 2 per window, with cooldowns.[/*]
[*][b]Idle reports[/b] — announces when nothing at all happens.[/*]
[*][b]Emote replies[/b] — reply to a friend's emote within 5 seconds for a two-person line (multiplayer only).[/*]
[*][b]Weather emotes[/b] — three of the same mood emote changes the weather, once per day.[/*]
[*][b]Morning Post[/b] — 4 lines each dawn: hardest worker, most social, step leaderboard, each praised by a villager friend.[/*]
[*][b]Editable text[/b] — all lines in 
[code]assets/*.json[/code], no recompiling.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Provide info on additional required steps, resources, or mods[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]

Manifest.Name: 鹈鹕镇广播中心
Manifest.Description: 联机社交 mod：把队友分头行动时的行为播报出来，让彼此知道对方在做什么；表情可以隔空回应；每天早上出一份《鹈鹕镇早报》。与心情有关的表情连击三次会改变当下的天气。
Manifest.Author: Claw
